label: Annual net stock pressure
explanation: Newham March-to-March stock change continued hypothetically. Applied to the common reference path, never to the player's reduced stock.

label: Eligible council homes
explanation: Assumed actionable pool, not extracted from the 671 council vacancies. Eligibility, prior commitments and demolition status have not been verified.

label: All-in restoration cost
explanation: Includes works and processing once; occupied-home repair spend is separate.

label: Annual restoration capacity
explanation: Delivery ceiling; funded homes mature next turn.

label: All-in acquisition cost
explanation: Assumed purchase, transaction and initial works cost. Not a verified borough house price.

label: Annual acquisition capacity
explanation: Acquisitions are for settled housing, not for use as temporary accommodation.

label: Suitable acquisition share
explanation: Rounded down per delivered cohort. Unsuitable homes incur operating costs but never create placements.

label: Delivery lag
explanation: Applies to restored and acquired homes. Year-one commitments arrive no earlier than year two.

label: Added-home operating cost
explanation: Charged on all completed additional homes every year, including unplaced homes. No rental income or terminal asset value credited.

label: Opening qualifying repair backlog
explanation: Synthetic count of occupied homes with one qualifying repair case; not inferred from complaints or non-decency.

label: New qualifying repair cases
explanation: New cases added before current-year repairs.

label: Repairs share of improvement allocation
explanation: Remainder funds retrofit. Retrofit improves homes and never reduces TA stock directly.

label: Cost per qualifying repair
explanation: One case per qualifying home; no health-outcome conversion.

label: Annual repair capacity
explanation: Current-year repair work completes at turn end.

label: Cost per retrofit
explanation: No energy savings or extra homes assumed.

label: Eligible retrofit pool
explanation: Separate from restoration pool and occupied repair backlog.
